svg.title: What moved, and why
svg.text: Every rank the reranker changed, in three groups.
IT READS QUESTION AND CHUNK TOGETHER
the chunk holding the value goes first
“How much time off do new dads get?”
“How soon must I report a lost laptop?”
“How to report” never says laptop · RRF, top 20
the last two need more than a reranker: context from another
section, and a reader that knows 40 > 25 and wine is alcohol
